blocks.text: O'zbek tilida qobiliyat va imkoniyat bir necha yo'l bilan aytiladi: «suza **olaman**», «suzishni **bilaman**», «bu yerda to'lash **mumkin**», «kirsa **bo'ladi**». Ingliz tilida bularning hammasi uchun bitta qisqa so'z bor — **can**: I **can** swim. You **can** pay here. **can** — modal fe'l: undan keyin fe'l `to` siz keladi, barcha egalar bilan shakli bir xil, inkor va savolga `do` kerak emas (might dagi qoidalar, → 29-dars).

rows: She **can** drive. — U mashina hayday oladi.
She **can't** drive. — U mashina hayday olmaydi.
**Can** she drive? — U mashina hayday oladimi?

blocks.text: Inkorning to'liq shakli **cannot** — bitta so'z qilib yoziladi («can not» emas). So'zlashuvda deyarli doim qisqa shakl **can't** ishlatiladi. Savolda **can** egadan oldinga chiqadi, xuddi be dagidek (→ 2-dars): You **can** swim. → **Can** you swim? Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi: Yes, I **can**. («Yes, I can swim» ham to'g'ri, lekin uzun).

items.text: I **can't** open this jar. It's very tight.
items.translation: Bu bankani **ocha olmayapman**. Juda qattiq yopilgan.

items.text: **Can** your son ride a bike? — Yes, he **can**.

blocks.text: **can** uch xil vaziyatda ishlatiladi. Birinchisi — **qobiliyat**: kishi biror ishni bajara oladi (I **can** play chess). Ikkinchisi — **imkoniyat**: sharoit bunga yo'l qo'yadi (You **can** buy tickets online — «chiptani internetda olsa bo'ladi»). Uchinchisi — **ruxsat**: You **can** sit here — «Shu yerga o'tirishingiz mumkin»; You **can't** smoke here — «Bu yerda chekish mumkin emas». O'zbekchada bu uch ma'no uchun turli shakllar ishlatiladi, inglizchada esa hammasi **can**.

**see**, **hear**, **smell**, **remember** kabi fe'llar bilan inglizlar ko'pincha **can** qo'shadi, o'zbekchada esa oddiy fe'l yetarli: I **can see** the sea — «Dengizni ko'ryapman», I **can't hear** you — «Sizni eshitmayapman», I **can't remember** — «Eslay olmayapman». Shuningdek, **can** kelajak reja haqida ham bo'ladi: I **can** help you tomorrow — «Ertaga sizga yordam bera olaman».

items.text: I **can smell** something burning in the kitchen.

blocks.text: **could** — **can** ning o'tgan zamon shakli. **could** — o'tmishdagi umumiy qobiliyat: My grandmother **could** sing beautifully — «Buvim chiroyli ashula ayta olardi». Inkori — **couldn't** (**could not**): I **couldn't** sleep last night — «Kecha uxlay olmadim». O'tmishdagi ruxsat va imkoniyat ham shunday: At my school we **couldn't** use phones — «Maktabimizda telefondan foydalanish mumkin emas edi». Savol: **Could** you swim when you were five? — Yes, I **could**. / No, I **couldn't**.

rows: I **could** swim when I was six.

blocks.text: Darak shakldagi **could** odatda **umumiy** qobiliyat uchun: He **could** read at the age of four. Bir martalik muvaffaqiyat haqida oddiy Past Simple (→ 11-dars) tabiiyroq: «Kecha nihoyat kalitni topa oldim» — I finally **found** the key. Inkor **couldn't** esa ikkala holatga ham mos: I **couldn't** find the key.

items.text: When he was young, my father **could** work all night.
The shop was closed, so we **couldn't** buy any bread.
items.translation: Do'kon yopiq edi, shuning uchun non **ola olmadik**.

blocks.text: Iltimos va ruxsat: Can you ...? Could you ...?

Birovdan biror narsa so'raganda **Can you ...?** yoki **Could you ...?** ishlatiladi. Bu yerda **could** o'tmishni emas, **xushmuomalalikni** bildiradi: **Could you** open the door? — «Eshikni ocha olasizmi?» — **Can you** ... dan yumshoqroq va hurmatliroq. Notanish odamga, o'qituvchiga, ishxonada **Could you ...?** xavfsiz tanlov. O'zingiz uchun ruxsat so'rasangiz — **Can I ...? / Could I ...?** («...sam bo'ladimi?»). Javoblar: **Sure. / Of course. / Yes, you can.** yoki **Sorry, I can't.**

items.text: **Can I** borrow your pen for a second?

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I can to swim.» → **I can swim.**; «He cans speak English.» → **He can speak English.**; «Do you can help me?» → **Can you help me?** (`do` yo'q); «I know swimming.» (o'zbekcha «suzishni bilaman» dan) → **I can swim.**; «I could came.» → **I could come.** (`could` dan keyin fe'lning oddiy shakli); «I can not» → **I cannot** yoki **I can't**.

Eslab qolish: «-a olaman», «...sa bo'ladi», «mumkin» — hammasi **can**; o'tmishda — **could**. Iltimos qilganda esa **Could you ...?** — eng xushmuomala va eng xavfsiz shakl. Taxmin ma'nosidagi «-ishi mumkin» uchun esa **might** (→ 29-dars): It **might** rain — It can rain emas.

examples.title: **can**: what people are able to do
examples.description: Qobiliyat: **can** + fe'l = «-a oladi», «...ni biladi». Barcha egalar bilan bir xil shakl, fe'l `to` siz.

sentences.text: My little sister **can** read and write now.
sentences.translation: Singlim endi **o'qiy va yoza oladi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **can** run five kilometres in twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Bekzod besh kilometrni yigirma daqiqada **yugura oladi**.

sentences.text: I **can** speak three languages: Uzbek, Russian and English.
sentences.translation: Men uch tilda **gapira olaman**: o'zbek, rus va ingliz tillarida.

sentences.text: Our dog **can** open the kitchen door on its own.
sentences.translation: Itimiz oshxona eshigini o'zi **ocha oladi**.

sentences.text: Emma **can** play the guitar, and her brother **can** sing really well.
sentences.translation: Emma gitara **chala oladi**, akasi esa juda yaxshi **qo'shiq ayta oladi**.

sentences.text: From our balcony you **can** see the mountains.
sentences.translation: Balkonimizdan tog'lar **ko'rinadi**.

sentences.text: Madina **can** cook plov for fifty people.
sentences.translation: Madina ellik kishiga palov **damlay oladi**.

sentences.text: In our office only James **can** fix the printer.
sentences.translation: Ofisimizda printerni faqat Jeyms **tuzata oladi**.

sentences.text: Sarah is only two, but she **can** already count to twenty.
sentences.translation: Sara atigi ikki yoshda, lekin yigirmagacha **sanay oladi**.

sentences.text: Grandad is eighty, but he **can** still ride a bike to the market.
sentences.translation: Bobom sakson yoshda, lekin hali ham bozorga velosipedda **bora oladi**.

examples.title: **can't** / **cannot**: what people aren't able to do
examples.description: Inkor: **can't** (to'liq shakli **cannot** — bitta so'z) = «-a olmaydi», «mumkin emas». Tasdiq va inkor yonma-yon kelgan gaplarga e'tibor bering.

sentences.text: I **can't** swim very well.
sentences.translation: Men unchalik yaxshi **suza olmayman**.

sentences.text: Aziz **can't** come to the phone right now — he's in the shower.
sentences.translation: Aziz hozir telefonga **kela olmaydi** — u dushda.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **can't** hear you — the music is very loud.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, sizni **eshitmayapman** — musiqa juda baland.

sentences.text: My grandmother **can't** read small letters without her glasses.
sentences.translation: Buvim ko'zoynaksiz mayda harflarni **o'qiy olmaydi**.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the bank **cannot** open an account without your passport.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, bank pasportingizsiz hisob **ocha olmaydi**.

sentences.text: Tom **can** drive, but he **can't** park!
sentences.translation: Tom mashina **haydashni biladi**, lekin uni joyiga **qo'ya olmaydi**!

sentences.text: Dilnoza **can't** eat nuts — she's allergic to them.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza yong'oq **yeya olmaydi** — unda yong'oqqa allergiya bor.

sentences.text: It's raining, so the children **can't** play in the garden.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir yog'yapti, shuning uchun bolalar bog'da **o'ynay olmaydi**.

sentences.text: I **can't** find my keys. Have you seen them?
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni **topolmayapman**. Ko'rmadingizmi?

sentences.text: James **can** understand Uzbek, but he **can't** speak it yet.
sentences.translation: Jeyms o'zbekchani **tushuna oladi**, lekin hali **gapira olmaydi**.

examples.title: **Can you ...?** — **Yes, I can.** / **No, I can't.**
examples.description: Savolda **can** egadan oldinga chiqadi: **Can** you ...? Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi: Yes, I **can**. / No, he **can't**.

sentences.text: **Can** you ride a horse? — Yes, I **can**.
sentences.translation: Ot **mina olasizmi**? — Ha, **olaman**.

sentences.text: Bekzod, **can** your brother swim? — No, he **can't**, but he's learning.
sentences.translation: Bekzod, ukang **suza oladimi**? — Yo'q, **olmaydi**, lekin o'rganyapti.

sentences.text: **Can** you see the bus stop from here? — No, I **can't**.
sentences.translation: Bu yerdan avtobus bekatini **ko'ryapsizmi**? — Yo'q, **ko'rmayapman**.

sentences.text: How many languages **can** Madina speak? — Four, I think.
sentences.translation: Madina nechta tilda **gapira oladi**? — Menimcha, to'rtta.

sentences.text: Who **can** help me with this heavy box? — I **can**!
sentences.translation: Bu og'ir qutini ko'tarishga kim **yordam bera oladi**? — **Men**!

sentences.text: Where **can** I buy a SIM card? — At the airport, near the exit.
sentences.translation: SIM-kartani qayerdan **sotib olsam bo'ladi**? — Aeroportda, chiqish yonida.

sentences.text: Mum, **can** we stay up late tonight? — Yes, you **can** — it's Friday.
sentences.translation: Oyi, bugun kech **yotsak bo'ladimi**? — Ha, **bo'ladi** — bugun juma.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **can** we pay by card here? — Sorry, only cash.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu yerda karta bilan **to'lasak bo'ladimi**? — Afsuski, faqat naqd pul.

sentences.text: **Can** your parents speak English? — My dad **can**, but my mum **can't**.
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz inglizcha **gapira oladimi**? — Dadam **gapira oladi**, oyim esa **gapira olmaydi**.

sentences.text: What **can** you see from your window? — Only the car park and a few trees.
sentences.translation: Derazangizdan nima **ko'rinadi**? — Faqat avtoturargoh va bir nechta daraxt.

examples.title: **can** / **can't**: it's possible, it's allowed
examples.description: **can** — faqat qobiliyat emas: imkoniyat («...sa bo'ladi») va ruxsat («...ishingiz mumkin»). **can't** — «mumkin emas», ya'ni taqiq yoki imkonsizlik.

sentences.text: You **can** buy train tickets online or at the station.
sentences.translation: Poyezd chiptalarini internetda yoki vokzalda **sotib olsa bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Visitors **can't** take photos inside the museum.
sentences.translation: Muzey ichida tashrif buyuruvchilarga **suratga olish mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: Students **can** use the library until ten in the evening.
sentences.translation: Talabalar kutubxonadan kechki soat o'ngacha **foydalanishlari mumkin**.

sentences.text: You **can** borrow my umbrella — I don't need it today.
sentences.translation: Soyabonimni olib **turishingiz mumkin** — bugun u menga kerak emas.

sentences.text: Sorry, you **can't** park here. It's only for buses.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu yerda mashina **qo'yish mumkin emas**. Bu joy faqat avtobuslar uchun.

sentences.text: From Tashkent you **can** get to Samarkand by fast train in two hours.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan Samarqandga tezyurar poyezdda ikki soatda **yetib borsa bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Children under twelve **can** travel free on city buses.
sentences.translation: O'n ikki yoshgacha bo'lgan bolalar shahar avtobuslarida **bepul yurishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: We **can** meet tomorrow — I'm free all day.
sentences.translation: Ertaga **uchrashsak bo'ladi** — kun bo'yi bo'shman.

sentences.text: Aziz, you **can't** use your phone during the exam.
sentences.translation: Aziz, imtihon paytida telefondan **foydalanish mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: In summer you **can** swim in the lake, but in winter you **can't** — it's frozen.
sentences.translation: Yozda ko'lda **cho'milsa bo'ladi**, qishda esa **bo'lmaydi** — u muzlab qoladi.

examples.title: **could** / **couldn't**: in the past
examples.description: **could** — **can** ning o'tgan zamoni: o'tmishdagi qobiliyat («-a olardi»). **couldn't** — «-a olmadi», «-a olmasdi», «mumkin emas edi».

sentences.text: When I was six, I **could** already swim.
sentences.translation: Olti yoshimda allaqachon **suza olardim**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **could** sew beautiful dresses when she was young.
sentences.translation: Buvim yoshligida chiroyli ko'ylaklar **tika olardi**.

sentences.text: I **couldn't** sleep last night because of the noise.
sentences.translation: Kecha shovqin tufayli **uxlay olmadim**.

sentences.text: Tom **couldn't** come to the lesson yesterday — he was ill.
sentences.translation: Tom kecha darsga **kela olmadi** — u kasal edi.

sentences.text: Ten years ago you **couldn't** buy this phone in Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: O'n yil oldin bu telefonni O'zbekistonda **sotib olib bo'lmasdi**.

sentences.text: We **couldn't** find a hotel, so we stayed with friends.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona **topa olmadik**, shuning uchun do'stlarimiznikida qoldik.

sentences.text: Madina **could** read before she started school.
sentences.translation: Madina maktabga borishidan oldin ham **o'qiy olardi**.

sentences.text: It was very dark, and I **couldn't** see the path.
sentences.translation: Juda qorong'i edi, men yo'lkani **ko'ra olmadim**.

sentences.text: The test was difficult, and many students **couldn't** answer the last question.
sentences.translation: Test qiyin edi, ko'p talabalar oxirgi savolga **javob bera olmadi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **could** speak French as a child, but she has forgotten it now.
sentences.translation: Sara bolaligida fransuzcha **gapira olardi**, lekin hozir unutib yuborgan.

examples.title: Requests: **Can you ...?** **Could you ...?** **Can I ...?**
examples.description: Iltimos: **Can you ...?** — oddiy, **Could you ...?** — xushmuomalaroq («...a olasizmi?»). Ruxsat so'rash: **Can I ...? / Could I ...?** — «...sam bo'ladimi?».

sentences.text: **Can you** pass me the salt, please?
sentences.translation: Iltimos, tuzni **uzatib yuborasizmi**?

sentences.text: **Could you** speak a bit more slowly, please?
sentences.translation: Iltimos, biroz sekinroq **gapira olasizmi**?

sentences.text: Excuse me, **could you** tell me the way to the station?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, vokzalga qanday borishni **aytib bera olasizmi**?

sentences.text: **Can I** have a glass of water, please?
sentences.translation: Bir stakan suv **olsam bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: **Could I** leave work early today? My son is ill.
sentences.translation: Bugun ishdan ertaroq **ketsam bo'ladimi**? O'g'lim kasal.

sentences.text: Dilnoza, **could you** help me with these bags? — Of course!
sentences.translation: Dilnoza, bu sumkalarni ko'tarishga **yordamlasha olasanmi**? — Albatta!

sentences.text: **Can I** try on this jacket? — Sure, the changing room is over there.
sentences.translation: Bu kurtkani **kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi**? — Albatta, kiyinish xonasi ana u yerda.

sentences.text: Mr Smith, **could I** ask you something about the report?
sentences.translation: Janob Smit, hisobot haqida bir narsa **so'rasam bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: **Could you** turn the music down a little? The baby's asleep.
sentences.translation: Musiqani biroz **pasaytira olasizmi**? Chaqaloq uxlayapti.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **can't** lend you my car tomorrow — I need it for work.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, ertaga mashinamni **bera olmayman** — ish uchun o'zimga kerak.

examples.title: Now and then: **can** ↔ **could**
examples.description: Hozir va o'tmish yonma-yon: **can** / **can't** — hozir, **could** / **couldn't** — o'tmishda. Tasdiq va inkor juftliklari.

sentences.text: Now I **can** drive, but two years ago I **couldn't**.
sentences.translation: Hozir mashina **hayday olaman**, ikki yil oldin esa **hayday olmasdim**.

sentences.text: At school Bekzod **couldn't** speak English at all; now he **can** talk to tourists easily.
sentences.translation: Maktabda Bekzod inglizcha umuman **gapira olmasdi**; hozir sayyohlar bilan bemalol **gaplasha oladi**.

sentences.text: Yesterday we **could** see the mountains, but today we **can't** — it's very cloudy.
sentences.translation: Kecha tog'lar **ko'rinib turgandi**, bugun esa **ko'rinmayapti** — havo juda bulutli.

sentences.text: My son **can** tie his shoes now. Last month he **couldn't**.
sentences.translation: O'g'lim endi poyabzali bog'ichini **bog'lay oladi**. O'tgan oy **bog'lay olmasdi**.

sentences.text: Grandad **could** run very fast when he was young, but now he **can't** walk far.
sentences.translation: Bobom yoshligida juda tez **yugura olardi**, hozir esa uzoqqa **yura olmaydi**.

sentences.text: Last week the internet was broken, so we **couldn't** watch anything. Now we **can**.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta internet buzuq edi, shuning uchun hech narsa **ko'ra olmadik**. Endi **ko'ra olamiz**.

sentences.text: This year Madina **can** afford a holiday abroad; last year she **couldn't**.
sentences.translation: Bu yil Madinaning chet elda dam olishga **puli yetadi**; o'tgan yili **yetmasdi**.

sentences.text: In the past people **couldn't** send messages in seconds, but today anyone **can**.
sentences.translation: Ilgari odamlar bir necha soniyada xabar **jo'nata olmasdi**, bugun esa buni har kim **qila oladi**.

sentences.text: Emma **couldn't** cook at all when she moved to London, but now she **can** make lovely dinners.
sentences.translation: Emma Londonga ko'chib kelganida umuman **ovqat qila olmasdi**, hozir esa mazali kechki ovqatlar **tayyorlay oladi**.

sentences.text: I **couldn't** answer that question yesterday, but today I **can**.
sentences.translation: Kecha u savolga **javob bera olmadim**, bugun esa **bera olaman**.

examples.title: Dialogue: at the hotel reception
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: mehmonxona qabulxonasida suhbat — **Can I ...?**, **Could you ...?**, **can** (ruxsat, imkoniyat) va **couldn't**.

sentences.text: — Good evening. **Can** I help you?
sentences.translation: — Xayrli kech. Sizga **yordam bera olamanmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, please. **Could** we have a room for two nights?
sentences.translation: — Ha, iltimos. Ikki kechaga bitta xona **bera olasizmi**?

sentences.text: — Of course. **Can** I see your passports, please?
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Pasportlaringizni **ko'rsam bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: — Here you are. **Can** we pay by card?
sentences.translation: — Mana. Karta bilan **to'lasak bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, you **can**. Breakfast is from seven till ten.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **bo'ladi**. Nonushta soat yettidan o'ngacha.

sentences.text: — Sorry, I **couldn't** hear you. From seven till when?
sentences.translation: — Kechirasiz, **eshitolmay qoldim**. Yettidan nechagacha?

sentences.text: — Till ten. And you **can** use the gym for free.
sentences.translation: — O'ngacha. Sport zalidan esa bepul **foydalanishingiz mumkin**.

sentences.text: — Great. **Could** you call a taxi for us at six tomorrow morning?
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. Ertaga ertalab soat oltiga bizga taksi **chaqirib bera olasizmi**?

sentences.text: — No problem. I **can** order it right now.
sentences.translation: — Muammo yo'q. Hoziroq **buyurtma bera olaman**.

sentences.text: — Thanks a lot. Oh, and **could** we leave our bags here after we check out?
sentences.translation: — Katta rahmat. Aytgancha, xonani topshirgandan keyin sumkalarimizni shu yerda **qoldirsak bo'ladimi**?
